У світі, де кіберзагрози стали частиною повсякденного життя, ми будуємо продукт, який змінює підхід до особистого цифрового захисту. Люди не хочуть бути гіками. Вони хочуть відчувати, що ситуація під контролем.

У кібербезпеці creative - це не про естетику, це про довіру.

- Ти даєш бриф так, щоб дизайнер зрозумів не "що намалювати", а "що має відчути людина".
- Ти працюєш з AI-інструментами як з частиною щоденного процесу, а не як з експериментом.

- Ти міряєш себе результатом, а не кількістю зроблених креативів.

Analytics at Runpod sits within Data & AI and serves as a strategic partner across the company. The team supports five core areas: marketing and PR; infrastructure and pricing; product; security; and sales. From acquisition and campaign performance to GPU-hour economics, product adoption, fraud detection, and revenue analytics, the team turns Runpod's rich operational data into decisions. This role will lead the established analytics function through its next stage of growth, determining how to staff, sequence, and scale coverage across the business while moving the team from answering questions to helping define the questions Runpod should be asking.

As Head of Analytics and Business Intelligence, you will lead and grow Runpod's analytics function, owning how the company measures itself and how insights reach decision-makers. You will manage a team of analysts and BI practitioners, set the analytics roadmap, and act as the senior analytics partner to Product, Supply, Finance, Engineering, Security, and Go-to-Market leadership.

Runpod's business is consumption-based and marketplace-shaped, which makes analytics genuinely complex. Demand-side revenue depends on GPU-hour utilization and workload mix across Pods, Serverless, and Instant Clusters, while supply-side economics depend on host behavior, capacity, and pricing. You will build the metric definitions, models, and self-serve layer that allow the company to reason about these dynamics consistently. You will shape how Runpod uses data to make company-level decisions. You'll have the opportunity to define the metrics that matter, proactively identify business opportunities, build a scalable analytics operating model, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for executives and the board. Success means creating an analytics function that not only responds to the business, but helps lead it.

- Drive company strategy proactively from a data perspective by identifying the data levers that can transform the business, quantifying opportunities, and delivering clear paths to action for leadership.

- Own Runpod's core metric layer, defining and maintaining consistent definitions for utilization, retention, net revenue retention, margin, and marketplace supply/demand health.

- Set the analytics roadmap in partnership with Product, Finance, and GTM leadership, balancing recurring reporting needs with deeper analysis that changes decisions.

- Drive analysis of consumption-based revenue and customer behavior, including cohort retention, expansion and churn on usage, savings plan adoption, spot vs. reserved mix, and serverless workload economics.

- Build the self-serve analytics layer so stakeholders can answer routine questions independently, reserving the team's capacity for higher-judgment work.

- Partner closely with Data Engineering on modeling, data quality, freshness, and SOC 2 requirements
